name: Taisen Mahjong Yarujan
source:
A strip mahjong against a single opponent (chosen out of many girls) with only handful of dialogue lines between the matches.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
與從眾多女孩中選出的單一對手進行脫衣麻將比賽。每局之間只有寥寥幾句對話。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]］
